jobs.prompt: Use-case: style-transfer / game texture edit. Image 1 is the exact edit target from a working 2D game. Image 2 is the approved flat character style reference ONLY. Make a refined FLAT 2D sprite replacement matching the original game. Preserve Image 1's composition, outer silhouette, pose, proportions, overall footprint, orientation, framing and transparent padding precisely. Keep the entire original object. It must still fit exactly in the original existing scene without moving anything. Flat opaque deep navy fill #182840, restrained blue teal contour strokes #35576e. Clear smooth vector-like linework, subtle contrast suitable for a background behind bright characters and particle effects. NO 3D, no realistic textures, no gradients, no lighting, no shadow, no bevel, no glow, no volumetric rendering, no backdrop, no UI, no labels. Transparent background. Do not include the character from Image 2. Output a single standalone asset. Edit the giant open palm, thumb pointing to the left, four fingers extending upward/right, and long wrist downward. Preserve precisely this asymmetrical hand silhouette with FIVE fingers. Redesign the interior line language: replace the busy scratch hatching with elegant sparse curving palm creases and thin repeated arc lines at the lower wrist. Add a very small flat muted gold four-point star mark in the lower central palm and two thin muted gold decorative arcs near the wrist, under 1 percent of area. Maintain a soft organic hand, not a mechanical gauntlet or armor. Keep long clean unadorned finger interiors except a few joint creases. Mostly empty navy fill, no filled bands. Native reference canvas is 3000x4000 portrait; preserve the same full hand framing and margins.
